subject: Post-call recap & next step checklist — HelioBank pilot criteria
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Bowman <kyle@heliobank.com>, Claire Roberts <claire@heliobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next step checklist — HelioBank pilot criteria

Hi Kyle / Claire —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs (what we heard)
- Primary goal: reduce fraud detection latency in payments pipeline and improve throughput for peak windows.
- Key decision criteria: p95 inference latency target < 200ms at production concurrency, predictable per-token unit economics, SOC 2 Type II and encryption at rest, option for VPC/private deployment for cardholder data flow.
- Stakeholder map (from call): Claire = internal champion (payments engineering); Economic buyer = Raj Patel, VP Payments; Security reviewer = Mina Ortega (security/compliance); Procurement = procurement@heliobank.com.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) Security questionnaire & artifacts — we will push the short security summary and SOC2 excerpts by Tue 2027-04-13 (attached: redwood-security-summary.pdf). Action: Mina Ortega / security reviewer to confirm any gaps.
2) Mutual action plan (MAP) draft — please review the attached MAP and call out any timeline constraints. Target: pilot kickoff week of 2027-04-25. (attached: HelioBank-MAP-draft.pdf)
3) Technical deep-dive w/ infra & infra-specific perf targets — propose Tue 2027-04-18 11:00am PT. Invitees: Claire, payments eng leads, our runtime engineering (Ben).
4) Procurement & legal — Kyle, can you confirm procurement timeline and the correct contracts contact? We can prepare a concise SOW + indicative pricing to unblock procurement.

Champion enablement (how our champion can pitch internally) — short talk tracks for Claire to bring Raj and procurement on board:
- ROI baseline: expect ~35% reduction in inference hardware spend when using Redwood batching & KV cache on comparable throughput; we will send a concise ROI snapshot after the technical call.
- Risk mitigation: automatic fallbacks to smaller model variant during peak and audit-ready logs for every request.
- Pilot scope recommendation: 4-week pilot focusing on peak window subset of transactions, measured on latency, token cost, and error rate.

Attachments: HelioBank-MAP-draft.pdf, redwood-security-summary.pdf

If this matches your readout, Kyle — can you confirm procurement contact and whether Raj prefers to be briefed by exec or engineer?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Kyle Bowman <kyle@heliobank.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Claire Roberts <claire@heliobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next step checklist — HelioBank pilot criteria

Thanks Jasmine — good summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement contact is procurement@heliobank.com (I'll loop them in if you want). Timeline: likely a 2-3 week review for an NDA + MSA redlines, then separate SOW approval.
- Raj (VP Payments) wants a one-page cost/benefit snapshot for exec review. Can you provide an indicative pilot price (ballpark) before the technical deep-dive? He prefers an exec-level brief rather than sitting through the infra call initially.
- Security: Mina asked if we can get the SOC2 report summary and any specifics about data retention / ability to purge logs on request.

I'll confirm whether Claire can join the 4/18 slot; she is the champion and will help coordinate internal attendees.

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next step checklist — HelioBank pilot criteria

Jasmine / Marissa — quick internal notes and a suggested champion enablement pack to push to Claire: 

Champion talk tracks (one-pagers / quick snippets)
- For Raj (economic buyer): emphasize predictable unit cost and delta vs current self-hosted GPU line items. One slide: 3-year TCO comparison (current infra + ops) vs Redwood Managed/Dedicated. Highlight predictable billing, lower effective $/concurrent-token at scale due to batching and prefix caching.
- For Mina (security): single-page security summary + SOC2 highlights, plus explicit answers on retention and purging (we can state retention default is 90 days for logs, option for 30/0 via private deployment).
- For Procurement: short procurement checklist (NDA, MSA redlines likely, PO process). Keep SOW template ready; suggest limiting pilot SOW to time + success criteria to accelerate.

ROI inputs I will prepare post-tech-call (ballpark now)
- Pilot: expected ~20-35% infra cost delta reduction; full-rollout could approach 30-40% net savings depending on model quantization choices.
- Ops reduction: reduced time to scale new models by ~60% because of runtime-managed kernels and routing.

Action items
- Marissa: can you draft the one-pager (exec ROI + procurement checklist) for Claire to circulate? Target: Mon 2027-04-12 EOD.
- Jasmine: I'll lead the technical deep-dive and prepare a short perf slide (p95 targets and sample QPS) for 4/18.

I'll mark up the MAP with the pilot success criteria and send a version after this thread.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Bowman <kyle@heliobank.com>, Claire Roberts <claire@heliobank.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next step checklist — HelioBank pilot criteria

Kyle / Claire — following up with the items we discussed.

1) Attachments: I attached a concise champion one-pager (heliobank-champion-onepager.pdf) and the security summary we mentioned. The one-pager includes an exec-friendly pilot price band (ballpark) and the 3-point ask Claire can use to brief Raj.
2) DocuSign & SOW: I've prepared a short SOW skeleton and created a DocuSign envelope to speed procurement reviews: https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/ABCD1234-HelioBank. If procurement prefers, we can convert to PO+SOW instead.
3) Technical deep-dive: Ben will run perf requirements and sample QPS. Proposed: Tue 2027-04-18 11:00am PT — confirm availability & list of internal attendees so we can send calendar invites.
4) Security materials: redwood-security-summary.pdf attached; SOC2 excerpts are included. Mina (or whoever is on the security side) — please let us know any follow-up items by Tue 2027-04-13 so we can prioritize.

Next asks for Claire (Champion checklist)
- Share the one-pager with Raj and procurement for a quick read (1 pager)
- If Raj prefers an exec-only briefing, we can do a 20-min exec summary before the deep-dive.
- Please confirm procurement contact and expected review cadence — we've CC'd procurement@heliobank.com to start the thread.

Thanks all — we want to keep this lightweight. Happy to adapt the pilot SOW scope to fit your procurement windows.

Warmly,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: heliobank-champion-onepager.pdf, redwood-security-summary.pdf
